verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs cover assigning a specific user as an item's Owner and moving items between Active, Resolved, Muted and Archived statuses, which covers assigning, resolving and ignoring (via Muted). Nothing in the pack shows time-based snoozing or automatic reopening of a resolved item when it recurs, and both are central to the story. Missing for 10: evidence of snooze, evidence of automatic reopen on regression, independent or hands-on corroboration of the triage workflow.
